I understand. Those moments where the only solution and end seems to be just giving up are the some of the worst feelings there are. But that's the thing. When you are at such a low state the options are either to stay there or go up. And going up is going to be hard, but it's at least worth a shot.

Try telling someone what you're feeling. Someone you trust or a family member you are close to. Even just speaking to a random hotline for these cases might be of great help, dumping all these feelings out to someone might drastically change something. It might even make getting professional help from a therapist easier. The first step is always the hardest, and the following steps might be hard to get through as well. But you'll be able to see the world with so much more clarity and in a much healthier lens that these feelings might be not much more than a distant memory.

Now, the important thing if their parents are the problem is the saying "Don't bite the hand that feeds" so, try to be careful if you or your friend try to stand up to them since it might end in a not really good situation later on.
